evidence.name: Screen field: Select progress stepper layout
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Select progress stepper layout" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Select progress stepper layout
sections.description: Determines the visual layout for progress steps. Circle displays steps as an orbital arrangement (no image container); Image Container First and Chart Container First show image/text in a container with progress bar. Defines which content elements are shown in each segment (image visibility, title, subtitle, description).
